C1759.title: MFA Fatigue Attacks Used to Extract Bypass Codes
C1759.summary: In April 2026, security analysis revealed that attackers are using MFA fatigue attacks as an auxiliary method, bombarding users with frequent MFA verification requests to pressure them into approving fraudulent requests, while simultaneously tricking them into disclosing MFA bypass codes, thereby completely circumventing MFA protection and gaining system access.
